player_prompt.intro:
Waxaad u tahay Cayaarta {player_id} ee Tic Tac Toe ee Kuantamka.
Calankaagu waa '{symbol}', oo tirooyinkaaga guuritaanka ay kor u kacaan {parity} (tusaale ahaan, X1, X3 ama O2, O4).

Ujeedo: Ku guulee adigoo sameeya saf ka kooban saddex calan aasaasi ah (kuwaas oo laga sameeyay isu socodka).

Sida Loo Ciyaaro:
- Markaasta, geli calan ayaan ah laba goobood oo kala duwan oo banaan iyada oo loo isticmaalayo qaabka '[a,b]'.
- Calamadani waxay isku xidhan yihiin, oo lagu magacaabo sida 'X1 / X1' ama 'O4 / O4'.
- Ma aad samayn kartid calan ayaan ah goobood oo horey u Burburtay (kuwaas oo ahaa calan aasaasi ah).

Qaacidada Burburka:
- Haddii guuritaankaagu abuuro silsilad gudub ku sameeysa grafafka isku xidhka, Burburka ayaa dhici doonta otomaatigga.
- Calan kasta oo ayaan ah ee ku jirta silsilada Burburka ayaa noqonaysa calan aasaasi ah hal mar oo kaliya oo laba fadhi oo leh.
- Calamada ayaan ee ku xidhan Burburka ayaa sidoo kale Burbur doonta.

Guusha:
- Ciyaarta ayaa dhamaanaysa marka cayaarta hal mar oo kaliya oo saddex calan aasaasi ah oo safka ku jiraan.
- Haddii labada cayaarta ay heli saf isla marka Burburka, mid ka mid ah max tirooyinka guuritaanka ee hoose ayaa guulee doonta.

Tusaale guuritaan: '[0,4]' waxay geli calan ayaan ah selooyinka 0 iyo 4.

board.current_board: Guddiga Tic Tac Toe Quantum: {board} Soo gudbi dhaqaaqidaada sida "[a,b]" si aad u dhigto calaamad kuleyliyaha laba meelood.

invalid_move.invalid_cells: Liiska lambarka aan sax ahayn ama lambarka lambarka la isku daray.
invalid_move.already_solidified: Mid ka mid ah unugyada ayaa durbaba la adkeeyay.

game_action.placed: Ciyaaryahanka {player_id} wuxuu dhigayaa astaantooda superposition inta u dhaxaysa unugyada {pos_a} iyo {pos_b}.

game_message.dependent_resolved: Xalka superposition-ka ku xiran. Unugga ({r}, {c}) hadda waa {symbol}.
game_message.last_cell_resolved: Xalka ugu dambeeya ee la xaliyay. Qolka ({r}, {c}) hadda waa {symbol}.

outcome.win: Ciyaaryahanka {player_id} wuxuu ku guuleysanayaa dhibco adag!
